title: MarketMind Demo: AI Customer Support
content: AI customer-support platforms typically compete on automation, response quality, integrations, analytics, and total cost of ownership. Key risks include model cost changes, vendor dependency, privacy requirements, and commoditization.

title: MarketMind Demo: SaaS Positioning
content: A strong SaaS positioning strategy should make the target customer, core problem, differentiated outcome, and proof point immediately clear. Enterprise buyers often evaluate security, reliability, integrations, implementation effort, and measurable ROI.
